name: luh-rheology-data-of-copsil-add-gel
notes:
All measurements taken with Modular Compact Series of Anton Paar AG rheometer at Institut für Transport- und Automatisierungstechnik (ITA) of the Leibniz Universität Hannover (LUH).

All measurements taken by Lennart Mesecke @IPeG under supervision of Tobias Biermann @IPeG.

All measurements taken at roomtemperature R_T=20°C.


The material was analyzed regarding viscosity und shear stress under given shear rates. 

Test series A contains measurements with shearrates from 0-200 1/s. B contains measurements with shearrates from 0-50 1/s, focussing on lower shear rates.

The analyses file contains the evaluated Herschel-Bulkley-parameters. Please note, that the Herschel-Bulkley-parameters unsufficiently fit the measurement data due to wall-slip effects during the measurements.

The measurements therefore should be viewed with caution, since wall-slip effect leads to underestimating the yield stress of the material.
